=Notes=
I am going to include some notes I took about names in various books as I read them. Basically I wrote down names of people, places, and terms. For the most part it was anything uppercased as that stood out. I am making all of them into links so I can see what does or doesn't have articles.

For the red links, I will then, in the future, go to the page numbers I have noted (or others can feel free to) to create articles on it. Prior to doing so I will most likely consult admins on whether or not it is okay, as Robert Jordan has, I've noticed in doing this, invented a HUGE amount of names which might only receive a single reference, never to be referenced again. Although many names I have seen repeated much later when you thought you'd never see them again.

I'd love to see a WoT MMO some day so I am hoping that perhaps developers could make use of these notes to check the books for minor characters who could be used as NPCs, bringing the literal universe to life.

I have some of my earlier notes packed away in some box so I'm making empty placeholder sections for them which I'll fill as I locate my notes with my old book.

My lists are bound to involve repetition as I will probably forget an earlier mention of a character, or I might purposefully list multiple pages in which they are listed to create larger potential of their having an article.

As best of my ability, the pages listed for each book should contain a reference to a given character. Although in some cases (such as when they are mentioned as a page transitions to another) it might be 1 off.
